methodological_rigor.justification: Pooled analysis of two phase II studies (RAGNAR: global tumor-agnostic; LUC2001: Asian patients). Patients with advanced cholangiocarcinoma after ≥1 prior line received erdafitinib (8 mg daily with option for pharmacodynamic-guided uptitration to 9 mg). Efficacy assessed: ORR, DOR, PFS, OS per blinded independent review committee. Safety analysis included. However: pooling of different trial designs/populations, no sample size calculation for pooled analysis, post-hoc design.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Erdafitinib targeting FGFR alterations in FGFR-positive cholangiocarcinoma (≤20% of cases). Previously approved for urothelial cancer. Direct applicability to treatment selection in FGFR-aberrant CCA. Addresses unmet need in this genomically-defined subtype.

reporting_quality.justification: Efficacy endpoints specified (ORR per blinded IRC, DOR, PFS, OS). Safety assessment documented. Missing: detailed baseline characteristics for pooled cohort, justification for pooling heterogeneous trial designs, statistical analysis plan for pooled analysis, handling of RAGNAR's tumor-agnostic design spanning multiple cancer types.

novelty_literature.justification: FGFR inhibition in FGFR-altered cancers established. Erdafitinib efficacy in urothelial cancer documented. CCA application is contextual extension rather than mechanistically novel.

writing_presentation.justification: Pooled analysis design described. Efficacy endpoints and safety monitoring transparent. Missing: detailed breakdown of baseline characteristics, subgroup analyses by prior therapy, geographic/trial-specific outcome comparisons.

key_strengths: Pooled analysis aggregating RAGNAR (global, tumor-agnostic) and LUC2001 (Asian) data provides largest FGFR-altered CCA cohort with erdafitinib
Efficacy assessed via blinded independent review committee (ORR, DOR, PFS, OS), reducing assessment bias
FGFR targeting in genomically-defined cholangiocarcinoma subset directly applicable to precision medicine
Pharmacodynamic-guided dosing (8-9 mg) demonstrates individualized treatment approach
key_concerns: Post-hoc pooled analysis design (not prospectively planned); heterogeneous trial designs and populations may confound results
Pooling RAGNAR (tumor-agnostic across cancer types) with CCA-specific LUC2001 introduces confounding from non-CCA enrollees
No sample size calculation for pooled analysis; statistical power for efficacy/safety conclusions unclear
Baseline characteristics, prior therapy distributions, and trial-specific outcomes not detailed in abstract
chief_reviewer.rationale: Clinically relevant pooled analysis of established mechanism. Post-hoc design and heterogeneous populations limit tier placement.
